annotations.title: A store's price adjustment and price match policy

description: Price Drop Back. A store's price adjustment and price match policy. For requests like "does Target do price matching?", "does John Lewis refund if the price drops?", "Currys price promise", "what's Best Buy's price adjustment policy?", "will Costco refund the difference?". With an item name it adds links to check today's price.

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) gives the UK policy where the store has one (Apple, Amazon, IKEA) and UK rules; it also picks the price links (US, GB and IE get local Amazon and eBay links). Default from the request.

item.description: Optional item name, up to 100 characters, to link today's prices for it.

store.description: Store name in everyday words, up to 60 characters.
